faqs.question: Is White Mist safe for front load washing machines?
faqs.answer: Yes, White Mist is low-foam optimized for all front load, top load, and semi-automatic machines.

faqs.question: Can I use it for delicate silks and baby clothes?
faqs.answer: Our Floral Bloom formula is 100% bleach-free, phosphate-free, and dermatologically tested for soft fabrics and sensitive skin.

faqs.question: How many washes do I get from a 2L bottle?
faqs.answer: A 2 Litre bottle delivers approximately 40 full loads (5-6kg machine load) using the recommended 40ml dosage cap.

faqs.question: Does White Mist leave white powdery residue on dark clothes?
faqs.answer: No! Liquid detergents dissolve 100% instantly in water, leaving zero chalky residue or fabric stiffness on dark or colored clothes.
